issues.title: Checkout Form Overload
issues.description: The single-page checkout asks for 19 fields at once; 7 of 18 participants abandoned at the address block.
issues.recommendation: Split checkout into three focused steps with a visible progress indicator and inline validation.

issues.title: Hidden Delivery Costs
issues.description: Shipping fees appear only at the payment step. Participants described the late reveal as a trust breaker.
issues.recommendation: Surface estimated delivery cost on the cart page and in the mini-cart summary.

issues.title: Guest Checkout Buried
issues.description: The guest option renders below the fold under the login form; 5 participants created unwanted accounts.
issues.recommendation: Present "Continue as guest" as an equal-weight choice on the checkout entry screen.

insights.title: Checkout Is the Primary Conversion Leak
insights.summary: Funnel analytics corroborate the lab findings: 61% of drop-off happens between cart and payment, concentrated on the address form.

insights.title: Users Price-Check Mid-Checkout
insights.summary: A third of participants opened a second tab to re-verify totals, signalling low confidence in the displayed pricing.

insights.title: Form Labels Fail Screen Readers
insights.summary: Placeholder-only labels disappear on focus; NVDA users could not recover field context. WCAG 3.3.2 failure.

insights.title: Express Payment Shortcut
insights.summary: Participants who saw the Apple Pay prototype completed purchase 2.4× faster; a promising quick win for mobile traffic.

issues.title: Nine-Screen Onboarding
issues.description: First-run tour takes nine swipes before any product value is shown; 40% of test users skipped blindly.
issues.recommendation: Cut the tour to three value-led screens and defer permissions until the moment of need.

issues.title: Notification Prompt Too Early
issues.description: The push-permission dialog fires on first launch; acceptance in the cohort was 9%.
issues.recommendation: Trigger the prompt after first successful order, framed around delivery updates.

issues.title: Unclear Sign-Up Value
issues.description: Participants could not articulate why an account was needed before browsing.
issues.recommendation: Allow anonymous browsing and present sign-up at wishlist or checkout with a concrete benefit.

insights.title: Skip Behaviour Masks Feature Blindness
insights.summary: Users who skipped onboarding failed the "find order history" task twice as often — the tour carries real signal when it is short.

insights.title: Progress Feedback Reduces Abandonment
insights.summary: The prototype with a step indicator held 31% more users through registration than the control.

insights.title: Carousel Fails Reduced-Motion Users
insights.summary: Auto-advancing onboarding cards ignore the OS reduced-motion setting and cannot be paused.

insights.title: Personalised First Shelf
insights.summary: Users who picked two interest categories during onboarding tapped 3× more products in their first session.

issues.title: Dashboard Information Overload
issues.description: The landing view shows 14 widgets with equal visual weight; merchants scan for 20+ seconds before acting.
issues.recommendation: Introduce a task-oriented "Today" panel with the three metrics merchants check every morning.

issues.title: Bulk Actions Undiscoverable
issues.description: Editing 50 product listings requires opening each one; the existing bulk editor was found by 1 of 9 merchants.
issues.recommendation: Expose bulk selection directly in the listing table with checkboxes and a persistent action bar.

issues.title: Ambiguous Order Statuses
issues.description: Merchants confuse "processing" and "pending" and phone support to clarify; both map to distinct fulfilment states.
issues.recommendation: Rename statuses in merchant language and add a hover glossary with next-action hints.

insights.title: Merchants Work in Recovery Loops
insights.summary: Observed sessions revolve around exceptions — failed payments, stuck orders — not the analytics the dashboard leads with.

insights.title: Table Density Beats Cards for Pros
insights.summary: Power merchants using the dense-table prototype completed inventory tasks 38% faster than with the card layout.

insights.title: Alert Digest Instead of Live Widgets
insights.summary: A morning email digest prototype was rated 4.6/5; it fits the observed "check then act" routine better than dashboards.

insights.title: Charts Rely on Colour Alone
insights.summary: Revenue vs refund lines are distinguishable only by hue; add markers and direct labels for colour-blind merchants.

issues.title: Zero-Results Dead Ends
issues.description: 14% of on-site searches return nothing, and the empty state offers no recovery path.
issues.recommendation: Add spell-tolerant matching, category suggestions and top sellers to the zero-results state.

issues.title: Facet Overload on Mobile
issues.description: Twenty-two filter facets render in a full-screen drawer; users lose their result context.
issues.recommendation: Prioritise five high-usage facets per category and collapse the long tail behind "More filters".

issues.title: Mega-Menu Hover Traps
issues.description: Diagonal cursor paths close the desktop mega-menu before users reach second-level items.
issues.recommendation: Add hover intent tolerance and make top-level categories clickable landing pages.

insights.title: Search Users Convert Double
insights.summary: Sessions that use search convert at 4.9% vs 2.4% for browse-only — improving search has outsized revenue leverage.

insights.title: Category Names Fail the Tree Test
insights.summary: "Lifestyle" and "Essentials" scored under 35% success; participants expected concrete nouns like "Home" and "Beauty".

insights.title: Autocomplete With Products
insights.summary: Prototype autocomplete showing product thumbnails cut time-to-first-result by half in testing.

insights.title: Keyboard Trap in Filter Drawer
insights.summary: Focus never returns to the trigger button when the drawer closes; tab order restarts at the page top.

issues.title: Inconsistent Button Variants
issues.description: Nineteen visually distinct button styles are live across the shop and dashboard; four exist in the design system.
issues.recommendation: Deprecate ad-hoc styles, publish migration codemods, and gate new variants behind design review.

issues.title: Undocumented Form Patterns
issues.description: Validation, error placement and helper text differ per team; the system documents none of them.
issues.recommendation: Ship a forms chapter covering validation timing, error copy tone and accessibility annotations.

issues.title: Token Drift in Dark Mode
issues.description: Hardcoded hex values bypass colour tokens in 31% of audited screens, breaking dark-mode contrast.
issues.recommendation: Add a lint rule that flags raw hex values and map the offenders to semantic tokens.

insights.title: Consistency Gaps Surface in Test Sessions
insights.summary: Participants hesitated when identical actions looked different across surfaces — component drift is a user-facing problem, not a code-quality one.

insights.title: System Adoption Correlates With Velocity
insights.summary: Teams above 80% component adoption ship UI stories 30% faster; the audit gives the business case for investment.

insights.title: Developers Copy the Nearest Screen
insights.summary: Survey shows devs copy patterns from adjacent code, not documentation — the system must live where the code lives.

insights.title: Focus Styles Removed Ad Hoc
insights.summary: Custom CSS strips focus outlines on 12 audited flows; the token-level fix restores them globally.

issues.title: Payment Sheet Context Loss
issues.description: The native payment sheet hides the order summary; 6 of 26 participants backed out to re-check totals.
issues.recommendation: Show a persistent one-line total with item count above the payment sheet.

issues.title: Address Autofill Mismatch
issues.description: OS-level autofill fills Polish addresses into the wrong fields, forcing manual correction.
issues.recommendation: Reorder fields to match platform autofill conventions and support postcode-first lookup.

issues.title: Promo Code Friction
issues.description: The promo field is hidden behind a chevron; users who arrived from a discount campaign missed it.
issues.recommendation: Auto-apply campaign codes from deep links and confirm with a dismissible banner.

insights.title: Express Checkout Delivers
insights.summary: The Apple Pay / BLIK rollout from the Q1 2024 recommendation now carries 34% of mobile orders with a 71% completion rate.

insights.title: Mobile Users Buy in Micro-Sessions
insights.summary: Median mobile purchase spans three app opens; persistent carts and restored state are conversion-critical.

insights.title: Saved Baskets Nudge
insights.summary: A prototype reminder for baskets abandoned 24h earlier recovered 11% in the A/B test cell.

insights.title: Dynamic Type Breaks Checkout
insights.summary: At the largest accessibility font size the pay button renders off-screen; 3.1% of sessions use these sizes.

product: Aurelo Web Shop — product detail & reviews

issues.title: Above-Fold Banner Blindness
issues.description: Heatmaps show the promotional carousel is skipped by 87% of viewers; it occupies the prime viewport slot.
issues.recommendation: Replace the carousel with the product gallery and move promotions below the buy box.

issues.title: Review Trust Deficit
issues.description: Participants distrust the uniform five-star wall; verified-purchase labels are missing.
issues.recommendation: Add verified badges, rating distribution and "most helpful critical review" to the summary.

issues.title: Size Guide Modality
issues.description: The size guide opens a full-page overlay losing gallery context; apparel returns cite sizing at 41%.
issues.recommendation: Inline the size table in an accordion and add fit feedback from previous buyers.

insights.title: Reviews Are the Second Stop
insights.summary: Gaze sequences show price → reviews within four seconds; review quality directly gates add-to-cart.

insights.title: Gallery Zoom Expectations
insights.summary: Pinch and double-tap zoom attempts on desktop imagery show users bring mobile gestures everywhere; add click-to-zoom.

insights.title: UGC Photos Lift Confidence
insights.summary: Products with customer photos convert 22% higher in the analytics cohort; prompt for photos post-delivery.

insights.title: Star Ratings Lack Text Equivalent
insights.summary: Screen readers announce decorative stars as unlabeled images; add an aria-label with the numeric rating.

issues.title: Report Builder Complexity
issues.description: Building a monthly sales report takes 12 configuration choices; merchants save one template and never explore.
issues.recommendation: Ship four opinionated report presets covering the tasks logged in 80% of diary entries.

issues.title: Export Format Confusion
issues.description: CSV exports flatten currency and locale formatting; accountants re-clean every file.
issues.recommendation: Add locale-aware XLSX export with typed columns as the default.

issues.title: No Comparison Baseline
issues.description: Reports show absolute numbers only; every diary participant computed period deltas by hand.
issues.recommendation: Add previous-period and same-period-last-year comparison columns with change indicators.

insights.title: Reporting Peaks Monday 7-9 AM
insights.summary: Diary data shows a sharp Monday-morning ritual; scheduled email delivery would meet merchants where they are.

insights.title: Presets Beat Builders
insights.summary: Preset prototype scored SUS 84 vs 61 for the builder — configurable power is worthless without a fast default.

insights.title: Benchmarks as Premium Feature
insights.summary: Merchants asked repeatedly how they compare to similar shops; anonymised category benchmarks tested at 4.8/5 interest.

insights.title: Data Tables Missing Headers
insights.summary: Generated report tables lack th scope markup, making them unnavigable with screen readers.

issues.title: Contrast Failures on Sale Badges
issues.description: Pink-on-white sale badges measure 2.9:1, under the 4.5:1 requirement, across 214 templates.
issues.recommendation: Move badges to the token system with an accessible colour pair and automated contrast checks in CI.

issues.title: Cookie Banner Keyboard Order
issues.description: The consent banner traps focus but its buttons come last in tab order; keyboard users tab through the whole page first.
issues.recommendation: Set initial focus to the banner, keep a logical order, and restore focus on dismissal.

issues.title: Video Content Lacks Captions
issues.description: Product story videos ship without captions or transcripts.
issues.recommendation: Add auto-generated captions with editorial review to the media pipeline.

insights.title: Two Years of Fixes Compound
insights.summary: The audit passes 91% of WCAG 2.2 AA criteria, up from 64% in the first 2024 baseline — regressions now cluster in marketing templates.

insights.title: Trust Signals Drive the SUS Gain
insights.summary: Participants cite transparent pricing and honest reviews — both prior-quarter fixes — as reasons for the record 82.9 SUS.

insights.title: Assistive-Tech Users Are Loyal
insights.summary: Screen-reader participants who succeed once return at twice the average rate; accessibility is retention work.

insights.title: Publish the Accessibility Statement
insights.summary: A public conformance statement with a feedback channel closes the loop and is required for the EU Accessibility Act.
